title: Home page-only dark luxury refinement (no layout/content changes)

requirements.text: Apply visual + motion refinements ONLY to the existing Home page and its home-route-specific styling, without changing routing, layout/structure, component hierarchy, or any text/content. Do not modify the visual appearance of any non-Home pages.

quotes: Modify ONLY the existing Home page layout. Do NOT change routing, structure, component hierarchy, or content. Do NOT modify any other pages.

acceptanceCriteria: Home page keeps the same sections and order (Hero, Crafting Quality Section, Feature Cards Section, CTA Section, Footer).
No text/content strings are changed on the Home page.
Non-Home pages (Products, About, Catalogue, Contact, etc.) render identically to before this change (no new backgrounds/animations/colors applied).

requirements.text: Remove all white/light backgrounds from the Home page by implementing a cohesive layered deep-navy background system with smooth blending and no hard breaks, matching: Top #0b1622, Middle #0f1f2f, Lower #0b1622.

quotes: Remove all white/light backgrounds. Use layered luxury gradient: Top: #0b1622 Middle: #0f1f2f Lower: #0b1622 Create smooth gradient blending between sections. No hard breaks between sections.

acceptanceCriteria: No Home page section uses a white/light background (including transitions/dividers).
Home page backgrounds visually blend from #0b1622 → #0f1f2f → #0b1622 without abrupt color jumps.
The Home page wrapper/sections use only the navy–gold–charcoal palette (no new accent colors introduced).

requirements.text: Upgrade the Home Hero section for readability and depth while keeping the current hero image. Add a cinematic dark overlay at rgba(0,0,0,0.55), increase headline contrast to #f5f2ea, add a soft text shadow, and keep the parallax effect very subtle (respect prefers-reduced-motion).

quotes: Keep current hero image. Add: • Dark cinematic overlay: rgba(0,0,0,0.55) • Improve headline contrast (#f5f2ea) • Subtle text shadow • Slight parallax effect (very subtle)

acceptanceCriteria: Hero image remains unchanged and still loads from /assets/generated/hero-equestrian-editorial.dim_1600x900.png.
An overlay equivalent to rgba(0,0,0,0.55) is present over the hero image to improve text readability.
Hero headline text color is #f5f2ea (or visually equivalent) and has a soft shadow for contrast.
Parallax effect is subtle and disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

requirements.text: Adjust Home hero entrance animations to match the specified luxury timing: Headline fade + rise over 900ms ease-out; subtext uses a 150ms delay; buttons use a 300ms delay. Keep motion subtle (no large movement), and disable animations under prefers-reduced-motion.

quotes: Add entrance animation: Headline: fade + rise (900ms ease-out) Subtext: 150ms delay Buttons: 300ms delay

acceptanceCriteria: On initial Home page load, headline animates with fade + small upward rise using 900ms ease-out.
Subtext animation starts 150ms after the headline begins; buttons start 300ms after the headline begins.
When prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, hero entrance animations do not animate (content is immediately visible without transforms).

requirements.text: Refine the Home Crafting Quality section to remove any light background and continue the deep-navy gradient. Constrain the text container width to 680px, increase vertical padding, add a thin centered gold divider line with animated expansion, and apply scroll reveal (fade + ~30px rise) while staying subtle. Optional: very subtle radial glow behind the heading.

quotes: Crafting Quality Section... Remove any white background. Use deep navy gradient continuation. Add: • Thin animated gold divider line (centered) • Increase vertical padding • Max width text container (680px) • Scroll reveal animation (fade + 30px rise) Optional: Very subtle radial glow behind heading.

acceptanceCriteria: Crafting section background is dark and blends with the overall Home gradient (no light/white panels).
Crafting section text container max width is 680px.
A thin centered gold divider line animates its width expansion (and is static if prefers-reduced-motion is enabled).
Crafting section reveals on scroll with subtle fade + rise (no flashy effects).

requirements.text: Update Home Feature Cards to a premium glass style with the exact richer card background and hover behavior: base background rgba(20,30,45,0.65), backdrop blur 12px, border 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15). On hover: slight lift (translateY -6px), brighter gold border, and a subtle glow shadow. Entrance animation must be staggered with 0.15s delay increments between cards and remain subtle; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

quotes: Convert to premium glass style: Background: rgba(20,30,45,0.65) Backdrop blur: 12px Border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15) Hover: • Slight lift (translateY -6px) • Border becomes stronger gold • Soft glow shadow Entrance: Stagger animation (0.15s delay between cards)

acceptanceCriteria: Each feature card uses rgba(20,30,45,0.65) background with 12px backdrop blur and a gold-tinted border at rgba(212,175,55,0.15).
Hover state lifts cards by ~6px, increases border gold intensity, and adds a subtle glow shadow (no harsh/big glow).
Card entrances are staggered by 0.15s between cards and are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

requirements.text: Upgrade the Home CTA section and the divider between Feature Cards and CTA: add a subtle thin horizontal gold glow line centered between sections (very thin, low opacity), keep CTA background dark, add a soft radial warm glow behind the CTA heading, and set CTA button gold to #c9a14a with hover glow + scale 1.03 and smooth 250ms transition.

quotes: Between feature cards and CTA: Add subtle horizontal gold glow line centered. Very thin. Low opacity.
CTA Section... Add subtle radial warm glow behind heading. Button: Gold (#c9a14a) Hover: • Glow • Slight scale • Smooth 250ms transition

acceptanceCriteria: A thin, centered, low-opacity horizontal gold glow divider is visible between the feature cards section and the CTA section (no bright or thick line).
CTA heading has a subtle radial warm glow behind it (kept understated).
CTA button base color is #c9a14a and hover uses a 250ms smooth transition with slight glow and scale to ~1.03 (scale suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion if necessary).

requirements.text: Make the Home footer fully dark luxury (no white) while ensuring non-Home footers are unchanged: set Home footer background to #08121a (or current home-footer-dark token updated to match), add top border 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15), set body text to #b8b8b8, and keep headings in soft gold. Footer must feel like a continuation of the Home page (no abrupt light break).

quotes: Footer (Critical) Remove white footer completely. Use: Background: #08121a Top border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15) Text: Body → #b8b8b8 Headings → soft gold Footer must visually continue the page — not feel separate.

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home route only, the footer background is #08121a with a top border rgba(212,175,55,0.15).
Home footer body text is #b8b8b8 and headings are gold-toned.
On non-Home routes, footer styling remains unchanged compared to before this change.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Home page only: do not modify other pages' visuals.
Do not change routing, layout/structure, component hierarchy, or any Home page content strings.
No white/light sections on the Home page.
No flashy animations, particles, or large motion; luxury motion must remain subtle.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling or minimizing motion effects.
nonGoals: New pages, new routes, or navigation changes
Changing any Home page text/content or swapping the hero image asset
Adding new sections or restructuring existing Home page sections
